gcp.gemini.gemini-2.5-flash-lite.tpm.note: Standard PayGo usage Tier 1 (30-day spend $10 to $250), org-level, per model, on the global endpoint. Higher tiers: 4M, 10M and 50M; bursts above it are served best effort. Throughput counts tokens per minute; Google publishes no multiplier for output tokens, so they count once. There is no separate requests-per-minute limit per tier ("There's no separate requests-per-minute (RPM) limit for each tier", https://docs.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/standard-paygo); multimodal requests have separate system limits
